spec_defects.description: The published ClassicQuote, BridgeQuote and WrapUnwrapQuote schemas have no required discriminator and permit additional properties. The provider-authored classic quote example matches multiple oneOf alternatives, so OpenAPI validation rejects both QuoteSuccess200 and the unmodified /swap request example. The node preserves the documented payload; its editor uses inclusive unions for these overlapping variants.
QuoteSuccess200 includes permitTransaction: null in its published response example, but permitTransaction is an object without nullable:true. Node test preserves the provider example including null.
